verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs describe GitHub Actions as a way to automate, customize, and execute software development workflows in the repository, and to ship with CI/CD. That is GitHub's native rule-based automation layer. Push protection automatically blocks pushes containing active secrets, and community notes mention automatic review assignment and scheduled reminders as built-in automations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event triggers (push, PR, issue events) and of the rule/workflow definition syntax, AI-native authoring of automation rules, and independent hands-on corroboration.
